title: Earth Observation Systems
definition: Earth Observation Systems (EOS) comprise space-borne and airborne satellite payloads designed to monitor, map, and collect quantitative and qualitative data about Earth's physical, chemical, and biological systems.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Prelims (Science & Tech, ISRO missions, remote sensing orbits) and Mains GS-3 (Space Technology, Disaster Management, Agriculture, and Internal Security applications).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Earth Observation Systems.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
